description: Chronic insomnia for 3 months, difficulty falling asleep, waking up multiple times
opening: Hello, I haven't been able to sleep well for the past three months. I keep waking up at night and can't fall back asleep.

description: Persistent sadness, loss of interest in activities, fatigue for 6 weeks
opening: Hi, I've been feeling really down lately. Nothing seems fun anymore and I'm tired all the time.

description: Severe anxiety attacks with physical symptoms (chest pain, shortness of breath)
opening: I need help. I've been having these terrible panic attacks where I can't breathe and my chest hurts. I'm scared something is seriously wrong with me.

description: Suicidal ideation without a plan, feeling hopeless and worthless
opening: I've been having thoughts that I'd be better off not being here. I don't have a plan or anything, but I can't stop thinking about it.

description: Difficulty concentrating at work, feeling overwhelmed by tasks
opening: I'm struggling to focus at work. Even simple tasks feel overwhelming and I can't seem to get anything done.

description: Social withdrawal, avoiding friends and family for weeks
opening: I've been avoiding everyone - my friends, my family. I just don't want to see anyone anymore.

description: Intrusive thoughts and compulsive behaviors affecting daily life
opening: I keep having these disturbing thoughts that won't go away, and I feel like I have to do certain things over and over to make them stop.

description: Excessive worry about health despite normal medical tests
opening: I'm constantly worried that I have some serious illness. I've been to doctors multiple times and they say I'm fine, but I can't stop worrying.

description: Trauma-related nightmares and flashbacks after a car accident
opening: Since my car accident two months ago, I keep having nightmares and flashbacks. Loud noises make me jump and I can't drive anymore.

description: Mild stress from upcoming exam, seeking coping strategies
opening: I have an important exam coming up and I'm feeling a bit stressed. I'd like to learn some ways to manage this better.
